name: Next Door Neighbors
source:
Welcome to Next Door Neighbors, an immersive and thrilling visual novel game that will take you on a captivating journey of self-discovery and exploration. Step into the shoes of a young man whose life takes an unexpected turn when his house burns down, forcing him to start fresh in a new city. As you navigate through this unfamiliar territory, you'll encounter a diverse cast of intriguing characters, each with their own compelling story to share.

[from [url=https://sexynoodle.itch.io/nextdoorneighbors]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到隔壁邻居，这是一款身临其境、惊心动魄的视觉小说游戏，它将带你踏上一段迷人的自我发现和探索之旅。扮演一个年轻人的角色，当他的房子被烧毁时，他的生活发生了意想不到的转变，迫使他在一个新的城市重新开始。当你穿越这个陌生的领域时，你会遇到各种各样的有趣角色，每个角色都有自己引人入胜的故事可供分享。

[来自[url=https://sexynoodle.itch.io/nextdoorneighbors]itch.io[/url]]
